notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: [h3]As promised, we've solved several issues that were found since our last patch. Please give the game a try and let us know if you encounter any new problems.[/h3][p][/p][h1][/h1][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Combo buffs no longer remain active after switching ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Retrying a level now correctly resets your build to the one you had at the start.[/p][/*][*][p]The mining beam no longer consumes power ammo or halt its regeneration.[/p][/*][*][p]Turret drones no longer use regular ammo or spend it on left-click.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage indicators now display as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]It's no longer possible to pause the game during events that have their own pause state, such as leveling up or viewing the demo splash screen.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Feature[/h3][list][*][p]Upon game over, you now have the option to retry the level with your current build. Doing so will forfeit all credits earned during that run. The credit cost for this option will increase with each subsequent retry.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX: v0.02a
notes.notes: [h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a minor issue where the game saved your credit amount every time credits were collected. The game now saves after earning 100 credits, at game over, when pausing, upon leveling up, or after completing an enemy wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the advanced ship class did not include its full starting build. The missing Tier 1 engine upgrade now correctly appears in the build menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the demo timer not pausing with the game. It now tracks time in sync with the rest of the game, preventing the demo splash screen from appearing when the game is paused.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Time!
notes.notes: [h3]No progress will be lost.[/h3][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/16b721c49c924b54fd544b77270315abb49edcbf.png"][/img]QoL Improvements[/h2][h3]Hints and Tooltips[/h3][list][*][p]Multiple additions to every menu now include a small tooltip explaining the function of each section. These tooltips will appear on every new game launch and will be addressed in a future update, allowing players to turn them off or reset them.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Level Unlocked[/h3][list][*][p]The level-up menu now explains how to upgrade your ship's systems, making it easier for new players during their first run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Menu Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]It’s now possible to return to the ship selection screen from the pause and game-over menus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Ship unlocked[/h3][list][*][p]The ship selection screen now displays a notification whenever a new ship is unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Builds[/h3][list][*][p]New ships come with preloaded tools and weapons suited to their class, making them easier to test immediately.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/6258e7d62d9b24c815ac845e08328141e8b9e837.png"][/img][/p][h3]More Upgrades[/h3][list][*][p]All ships now come with two slots to improve armor, engines, or add tools as intended. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][h3]Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Significant performance enhancements have been made. Changes to how multiple textures and animations are loaded have greatly increased game performance, reducing slowdowns when many enemies are on screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Better music performance[/h3][list][*][p]Music is now loaded upfront at the start of each run, preventing stuttering caused by loading new tracks mid-run.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Laser weapons no longer break when the game is paused at the wrong moment.[/p][/*][*][p]Tech slots on certain ship classes now appear correctly during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]The ship selection screen now properly displays newly unlocked ships on the first load.[/p][/*][*][p]Some menus no longer send players to the wrong screen or the title screen unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Music no longer cuts off prematurely under certain conditions, such as game overs.[/p][/*][*][p]Smaller shockwaves no longer cause zero damage to surrounding objects.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]End of transmission...[/p][p][/p]
